title: BILL Launches New AI Agents for Touchless B2B Transactions
summary: BILL is launching BILL AI agents to give SMBs the tools and teams they need to compete and win.
body_text: October 28, 2025 Closing the gap between the Fortune 500 and the Fortune 5 Million The Fortune 500 have the tools and teams to win. The Fortune 5 Million—the small and midsize businesses driving our communities and national economy—don’t. BILL exists to change that. Every business deserves the people, power, and financial intelligence they need to succeed and grow. Today, we’re taking a major step toward making that a reality. BILL has been using AI for years, and now, we’re launching BILL AI agents to give SMBs the tools and teams they need to compete and win. Large enterprises have spent decades buying their way out of friction with more people, tools, and systems. But SMBs haven’t been able to access the same capabilities. Every day is a trade-off between speed and control; serving customers and staying on top of the books; moving forward and catching up. Take something as simple as a W-9. Still a manual, mandatory form. Still a time sink. Still one of the biggest sources of IRS stress for businesses. Automation was supposed to fix that. But digitizing a manual workflow is not the same as deleting it. That's where BILL AI comes in. The problem with “more” SMBs don’t need more AI. They need better AI built specifically for their needs. Too many companies are racing to pile on features. More dashboards, more chatbots, more noise. But “more” isn’t how we define progress. True innovation isn’t about adding layers—it’s about removing limitations. At BILL, we measure success by how much friction we eliminate, and how much opportunity we unlock. How much time we give back. How much complexity we remove. How much confidence and capability we deliver. Because businesses don’t need more tools or more hype. They need less. Less work, less friction, less noise—so they can focus on what really matters: growing and winning. That’s the future we’re building. The future is touchless Web apps digitized manual workflows. Agents, when built well, get rid of them. With BILL AI, we’re building towards a future of touchless B2B transactions. Think: A world where business operations run themselves, while people stay in control. Receipts reconcile themselves. Expenses complete autonomously. Users onboard seamlessly. Books balance automatically. Payments delivered securely and efficiently. The ability to scale capability without scaling headcount. Autonomous finance that drives at the speed of business with accuracy, reliability, and security. That future starts today, with some of the biggest pain points for business: W-9s and receipts. Touchless tax compliance with the BILL W-9 Agent BILL W-9 Agent is the first in the industry. It automatically requests, collects, and pre-validates W-9s—making the thing no business wants to touch, truly touchless. More than 90% of business leaders say collecting W-9s is the most painful part of tax reporting. This agent eliminates more than 80% of the steps in the process. It has the potential to erase 650,000 hours of work to collect up to 3 million W-9s from the 1099-eligible vendors our customers do business with. With pre-validation, IRS stress disappears. And by Thanksgiving, the agent is expected to be available to 170,000+ businesses, making tax compliance faster, easier, and more reliable. Touchless receipts with the BILL Reconciliation Agent BILL Reconciliation Agent automatically codes transactions so receipts reconcile themselves. Since starting to roll it out with customers, we’ve seen a 533% increase in transactions coded entirely by AI, with a more than 90% accuracy rate that will continue to improve as the agent learns from more data. For our Spend & Expense customers, this matters. They manage over 72 million receipts a year—the equivalent of 500 tons of paper. Our goal is simple: to ultimately make tens of millions of receipts totally touchless. Touchless setup with agentic-powered onboarding We’re automating user onboarding for Spend & Expense, and using agentic capabilities to tailor the onboarding to each business. This new feature will automatically create virtual cards and permissions, ensuring every employee can start spending compliantly from day one. This is onboarding without the onboarding. A setup that happens behind the scenes, so new users can focus on their jobs, not their tools. When we talk about removing friction, this is what we mean. The moment someone joins your company, they’re ready to spend, operate, and contribute. Touchless assistance and beyond Our agentic-powered customer experience extends that same philosophy. BILL Assistant will deliver personalized, instant answers, make intelligent recommendations, and complete tasks on behalf of customers—so they can spend less time managing the back office and more time growing their business. And this is just the beginning. Next up: touchless travel, touchless email replies, touchless AP coding, and more. Every BILL AI agent is being built and trained to remove friction, save time, and unlock opportunity. Why BILL can build for the Fortune 5 Million We’re trusted by more SMBs and accountants than anyone in our space—nearly half a million customers, 9,000 accounting firms. We transact ~1% of US GDP. And up to a quarter of US SMBs—8 million—are represented in our network. Our AI is trained on more than $1 trillion in transactions and more than 1.3 billion documents, powering smarter, faster, and more secure agents. We’ve already increased automated bills by 80% and stopped 8 million fraudulent attempts last year alone. This scale, data, and trust, when combined with our unique approach to eliminating workflows, is what sets BILL apart. We’re building AI that works for SMBs—not just with them. The future of fintech isn’t about faster workflows. It’s about making work disappear. For the Fortune 5 Million, that future starts now.

title: The fastest way to migrate your dbt projects to Databricks is here
summary: Datafold now offers the fastest way to migrate dbt projects to Databricks—automating what once took months of manual work or expensive SI services. Our AI-powered Migration Agent handles everything from translation to validation, delivering production-ready dbt models in weeks. As an official Databricks Delivery Partner, we eliminate procurement friction so you can get started immediately.
body_text: If you’re among the tens of thousands of teams using dbt, you’ve likely considered how its portability could let you optimize for different platform advantages. We’ve heard from many teams interested in moving their dbt workloads to Databricks for cost savings and unified AI/ML capabilities. These teams face a common challenge: simply moving dbt projects to a new cloud warehouse can require months of manual work or SI services costs that offset the savings they’d gain from moving. We solved that problem. Datafold now offers a streamlined experience for migrating dbt projects from any warehouse to Databricks—turning what used to be a months-long project (often demanding hundreds to thousands of engineer-hours from your team) into an automated solution that outputs fully validated code in just weeks. We’ve cut out all the nonsense Here’s what makes this different from every other migration approach you’ve encountered: we’ve eliminated both the administrative and technical complexity that have made it challenging to justify moving dbt projects from platform to platform. The process is remarkably simple: Connect your systems: Link your dbt project repo, legacy warehouse, and your Databricks account Hit start: Our AI-powered agent automatically handles code translation and validation Get production-ready code: We deliver translated dbt models in your repository of choice, complete with data validation proving parity Our team will oversee the entire process, so if the Datafold Migration Agent identifies discrepancies or edge cases a human will jump in and make adjustments. And because Datafold is part of the Databricks Delivery Partner Program, Databricks customers can contract with Datafold directly through their existing cloud platform agreements. No separate contracts, NDAs, or security reviews. Perfect for full migrations or evaluations Teams are moving their dbt projects to Databricks for cost optimization, performance gains, and access to unified AI capabilities. Others want to evaluate Databricks first—migrating a subset of their dbt models to run side-by-side comparisons before committing to a full migration. Both scenarios previously required months of manual translation and validation work. Now either can be accomplished in weeks. Get started Ready to migrate your dbt project to Databricks? Book time with our team to discuss your specific timeline and requirements.

title: How to Effectively Conduct an Expert Interview
summary: Discover how private equity firms and M&A advisors use expert interviews to validate assumptions, uncover risks, and gain insider insights. Learn best practices for sourcing experts, preparing due diligence calls, and streamlining workflows.
body_text: Why Expert Interviews Matter in M&A and Private Equity ‍ In high-stakes M&A transactions and private equity due diligence , timing and information quality can determine deal success. That’s why expert interviews —also called expert network calls or due diligence calls —have become a cornerstone of deal research. By speaking directly with former executives, industry specialists, or key customers, investors gain insights no report or database can capture . Expert calls validate assumptions, highlight hidden risks, and surface market nuances that drive smarter deal decisions. In the words of industry leaders, expert networks act as: “Brokers of knowledge – all the stuff that is too niche, quirky, timely or contextual for anyone to put in writing.” ‍ How PE Firms and M&A Advisors Use Expert Calls ‍ Private Equity Firms ‍ Early-stage screening: Landscape industries before pursuing targets. ‍ Commercial due diligence (CDD): Validate market growth, customer demand, and competitive positioning. ‍ Investment thesis support: Dozens of expert calls per deal to confirm or challenge assumptions. ‍ M&A Consultants and Advisors ‍ Fact-finding and benchmarking: Pinpoint hard-to-find data points (growth rates, customer behavior, competitor share). ‍ Risk validation: Reduce reliance on single opinions by conducting multiple calls. ‍ Consensus building: Seek a “true north” through recurring themes across expert perspectives. ‍ Building a Scalable Expert Call Workflow 1. Source Across Multiple Expert Networks No single provider (GLG, AlphaSights, Third Bridge, Guidepoint, niche networks) has complete coverage. Tapping 3+ networks increases your odds of finding highly relevant experts. 2. Give Clear Briefs to Networks Define what you need: geography, seniority, function, and industry role. For example: “Former sales VP at a Tier 1 EV battery supplier in China.” Prompt, transparent feedback accelerates sourcing. 3. Track Experts Systematically Use an Excel or CRM tracker to avoid duplicate bookings, log bios, and record call outcomes. This builds an internal knowledge base for future deals. 4. Streamline Time Management Batch review profiles daily at a set time. Prioritize the most critical experts early. End calls early if relevance is low — experts understand this is part of the process. ‍ Best Practices for Expert Interview Preparation ‍ Select the Right Experts Prioritize recent, first-hand experience directly linked to your thesis. Avoid conflicts of interest — e.g., current employees of the target. Ensure compliance with MNPI (Material Non-Public Information) restrictions. ‍ Prepare Key Questions Outline 3–5 must-have questions. Start broad, narrow down: trends → competition → customer behavior. Use neutral phrasing to avoid confirmation bias. ‍ Conduct Objective Calls Lead with your top questions to confirm relevance. Use ranges to help quantify (“flat, 5%, or 10%+ growth?”). Cross-check critical insights with multiple experts. ‍ Capture and Reuse Insights Take structured notes or request transcripts. Summarize 2–3 takeaways per call. Build a knowledge base that compounds across deals. ‍ Stay Compliant Never solicit confidential or MNPI data. Partner with reputable networks that train experts on compliance. Protect your firm’s legal and reputational standing. ‍ The Strategic Advantage of Expert Calls In M&A and PE, expert interviews are a competitive edge , not just a diligence checkbox. Speaking to insiders accelerates clarity and builds conviction. The challenge? Managing multiple networks and dozens of calls. That’s where aggregation platforms like Inex One add value—integrating 25+ expert networks into a single dashboard with unified compliance, scheduling, and transcripts. As one user put it: “Inex One reduces the admin burden, leaving more time to spend speaking to the experts.” ‍

title: Oscar Health Welcomes Two Healthcare Veterans to its Executive Leadership Team
summary: Oscar Health, Inc. today announced the appointment of two seasoned healthcare executives to round out its leadership bench and further propel its vision to refactor healthcare.
body_text: NEW YORK, September 6, 2023 – Oscar Health, Inc. (“Oscar”) (NYSE: OSCR), the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform, today announced the appointment of two seasoned healthcare executives to round out its leadership bench and further propel its vision to refactor healthcare. Kerry Sain has joined the company as the Executive Vice President of +Oscar, effective August 14, 2023, and Steven Kelmar will join as Executive Vice President and Chief of Staff to the CEO, effective September 21, 2023. In her role, Sain oversees the go-to-market strategy for the +Oscar business and will work closely with Mario Schlosser, President of Technology and Chief Technology Officer, to continue externalizing the technology platform to power every aspect of the healthcare system. Prior to joining Oscar, Sain served as the Chief Commercial Growth Officer for Aetna, Inc., where she managed all segments across its extensive commercial markets medical business. Before Aetna, she held a variety of senior leadership positions at 13D Research & Strategy, SAP America, Inc., bswift, and Mercer. Sain serves on the Executive Committee of the Foundation for the University of the Virgin Islands and the Board of Directors of digital-health company Mightier. “Kerry is an absolute powerhouse,” said Mark Bertolini, CEO of Oscar. “I had the pleasure of working alongside Kerry during my time at Aetna, and have seen first-hand her ability to drive aggressive growth strategies, build cutting-edge software-as-a-service offerings, and effectively scale businesses. I believe Kerry’s leadership, combined with Oscar’s member engagement and technology superpowers, will set +Oscar up for continued expansion.” In his role, Kelmar will be responsible for driving corporate strategy, guiding Oscar’s long-term growth roadmap, and evolving executive management processes at the company. Kelmar previously served as Senior Vice President of Strategy Implementation at CVS Health Corporation and as Chief of Staff and Executive Vice President, Head of Strategy, for the Office of The Chairman and CEO at Aetna Inc. He has held a number of senior executive positions at Novartis and Medtronic. Kelmar also served in President George H. W. Bush’s administration as an Assistant Secretary at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Bertolini continued, “Steve brings an incredible track-record of accelerating business value creation and performance. He is a long-time, trusted colleague who is joining at a pivotal moment in Oscar’s history – with strategic targets, like achieving profitability, within reach. I am confident Steve’s invaluable leadership and deep alignment to our mission will help guide us through our next phase of growth and catapult Oscar’s future forward." About Oscar Health Oscar Health, Inc. (“Oscar”) is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving its members. At Oscar, our mission is to make a healthier life accessible and affordable for all. Headquartered in New York City, Oscar has been challenging the health care system's status quo since our founding in 2012. The company’s member-first philosophy and innovative approach to care has earned us the trust of nearly one million members, as of June 30, 2023. We offer Individual & Family, Small Group and Medicare Advantage plans, and +Oscar, our full stack technology platform, to others within the provider and payor space. Our vision is to refactor health care to make good care cost less. Refactor is a term used in software engineering that means to improve the design, structure, and implementation of the software, while preserving its functionality. At Oscar, we take this definition a step further. We improve our members’ experience by building trust through deep engagement, personalized guidance, and rapid iteration.
